data.name: Aadhya
data.gender_notes: Aadhya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: First; the first power; the beginning
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ādi, 'beginning, first', with the feminine suffix — 'the first power'. Its root is Sanskrit ādi (आदि). An epithet of the goddess as the primordial power. Aadhya is a Sanskrit name meaning “First; the first power; the beginning”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadhya expresses “First; the first power; the beginning”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ādi, 'beginning, first', with the feminine suffix — 'the first power'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadhya total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
